verdict.rationale: The provider's own pages describe it as an attorney-led boutique immigration law firm operating since 1993. They state that all work is done under close attorney supervision and reviewed by an attorney before submission, with paralegals and legal writers supporting the attorneys. That is a stated attorney-supervised filing model, not an unsupervised form service. missing for 10: named individual attorneys with bar licensure details, explicit attorney-of-record (e.g., G-28) filing statement, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my petition is prepared and filed by licensed immigration attorneys — named lawyers or a stated attorney-of-record model on the provider's own pages, not an unsupervised form service
